content: Whereby, M., and Bayless, T.M. (October 1965) published a study titled Long-term antibiotic therapy in tropical sprue in the Annals of Internal Medicine, Volume 63, Issue 4, pages 619–634. The study is indexed under ISSN 0003-4819 and has the PubMed ID (PMID) 5838328. Ferri, Fred (2015) authored Ferri's Clinical Advisor 2016: 5 Books in 1, published by Elsevier Science Health Science. The book is identified with the ISBN 978-0323280471.
